answer_1.quote: We aim to generate much longer "short" stories: the final generated stories in our experiments are 2000-2500 words.

answer_4.quote: All metrics are judged by Amazon Mechanical Turk workers, who are shown a premise and two corresponding stories in random order... Each pair of stories is judged by three workers.
answer_4.guideline: Workers compare two stories on interest, coherence, relevance (choosing which is better or neither), and individually mark each story for humanlikeness and writing issues.
